projectionWideLimitations.note: Descriptions may expose semantic result/validation contracts that are not structurally encoded.
projectionWideLimitations.batch2StrongestGenericization: GitHub.create_tree.tree_elements items are projected only as { [key: string]: any }.
projectionWideLimitations.batch3ConcreteErrorEvidence: GitHub.fetch_pr_file_patch documents patch=null for a valid PR missing the path, plus 404 for unresolved repository/PR and a no-retry-other-paths instruction.
projectionWideLimitations.batch5ConcurrencyEvidence: GitHub.merge_pull_request.expected_head_sha explicitly rejects merge when PR head moved.
projectionWideLimitations.batch5CursorEvidence: GitHub.search_branches exposes opaque cursor input while any output hides the returned next-cursor field.
